alignment_check.method: Read all 125 Kyrgyz/English paired verses; corrected p485:l022–023 clause placement. Visual comparison of all three PDF pages. One unresolved verse separately preserved and not counted as English.

excluded_source_ids.reason: Legible wording remains syntactically unresolved; not counted as English translation.

unresolved_passages.note: Тоорак = black poplar; жоргодо appears to mean on a pacer, but poplar-bearing pacer is semantically opaque. No invented place name or silent emendation. Further lexical check pending.

transcription_check.scope: Faithful transcription of digital PDF, including visible defects; not archival verification.

notes.manas-2010:p0483:b001:l007: Ала көөдөн rash/simple-minded, not literal piebald chest. Yudakhin and 1969 dictionary: https://el-sozduk.kg/koodon-2/.
notes.manas-2010:p0483:b001:l020: Кайыптан inspiration from the unseen; not ordinary tactical deduction asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0483:b001:l026: Тоорак black poplar, Yudakhin and 2015 dictionary https://el-sozduk.kg/тоо/. Following verse remains unresolved separately.
notes.manas-2010:p0483:b001:l029: Hell metaphor retained; чогуу together/all, not a newly specified battle.
notes.manas-2010:p0483:b001:l031: Thousand camels of tea, not a thousand cups.
notes.manas-2010:p0483:b001:l037: Атаңдын көрү paternal-grave curse rendered idiomatically; not actual grave described.
notes.manas-2010:p0484:b001:l008: Source explicitly says Orgo although surrounding challenge is to Zholoy and Orgo has been killed. Name preserved, narrative contradiction not silently corrected.
notes.manas-2010:p0484:b001:l018: Teeth crackling like millet is source hyperbole, not assertion teeth broke out.
notes.manas-2010:p0484:b001:l023: Source contrast: cattle rather than horses. Preserved though earlier narrative features horses.
notes.manas-2010:p0484:b001:l037: Торучаар horse name retained; сан flank/thigh.
notes.manas-2010:p0484:b001:l042: Бир тогуз one company of nine spiritual supporters; exact identities not supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0485:b001:l002: Repeated company of nine retained without merging supporters and protectors.
notes.manas-2010:p0485:b001:l008: Ырас бала literally truly a boy; contextual diminishment of Zholoy provisional, not biological age asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0485:b001:l009: Heat and cold paired images of Manas’s power; no actual change of weather asserted here.
notes.manas-2010:p0485:b001:l011: Horse Achbuudan retained; control of mouth means turning horse by bridle.
notes.manas-2010:p0485:b001:l015: Борчук rocky outcrop; Yudakhin https://tamgasoft.kg/dict/index.php?alf1=б&alf2=бо&cur_page=12&dic_id=2&page=list_words. Бута бою approximate target/bowshot distance, no modern measurement.
notes.manas-2010:p0485:b001:l017: Toruchaar is Manas’s mount. Abrupt narrative perspective switch preserved; not reassigned to Zholoy.
notes.manas-2010:p0485:b001:l021: As though rider had died is explicit simile; no actual death of Manas.
notes.manas-2010:p0485:b001:l028: Жолугуп meeting/encounter, connected to pending ambush, not a newly invented conversation.
notes.manas-2010:p0485:b001:l030: Кубулган transformation literal magical register; not merely disguises.
notes.manas-2010:p0485:b001:l031: Кытай бузуларда China in disorder, prospective/habitual formula; not a dated event.
notes.manas-2010:p0485:b001:l035: Жайчы weather-conjurer; оюнпоз performer/trickster. No particular magic rite invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0485:b001:l039: Source pig epithet retained as swinish; narrator rhetoric.
notes.manas-2010:p0485:b001:l042: Маша firearm cock/trigger or matchlock ignition, Yudakhin and 1969 https://el-sozduk.kg/маша/. Broad firing mechanism avoids specifying modern weapon.
notes.manas-2010:p0484:b001:l012: Бел артында behind ridge; hunched posture visible. Possible bodily waist-related reading left provisional.
